name: Complete Multi-Source Return with Medical and Donations
description: Open StudioTax 2024 and complete a comprehensive tax return for Han Park, a married Ontario taxpayer with two employers, medical expenses, and charitable donations. Read the scenario file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\TaxScenarios\scenario_multi_employer.txt for all data. Enter the following: (1) Personal information — name: Han Park, SIN: 557-890-121, DOB: November 30, 1985, marital status: Married, province: Ontario, address: 88 Dundas Street West Unit 3, Toronto ON M5G 2C2. Enter spouse Soo-Jin Park (SIN: 568-901-232, net income: $42,000) and two children: Min-Jun (DOB: 2018-06-15) and Ji-Yeon (DOB: 2021-03-22). (2) Add T4 slip #1 from Maple Leaf Financial Services — Box 14: $32,000, Box 16: $1,700.50 CPP, Box 18: $531.20 EI, Box 22: $4,200 tax deducted, Box 40: $500 taxable allowance. (3) Add T4 slip #2 from Great Northern Consulting — Box 14: $28,000, Box 16: $1,462.50 CPP, Box 18: $464.80 EI, Box 22: $3,100 tax deducted. (4) Enter medical expenses on Line 33099: prescriptions $1,200, dental $1,400, eyeglasses $450, physiotherapy $780 (total $3,830) for the period January-December 2024. (5) Enter charitable donations on Schedule 9: Canadian Red Cross $500, SickKids Foundation $400, United Way Greater Toronto $300 (total $1,200). (6) Navigate to the Summary page and confirm that total income, total deductions, and net federal tax are displayed — if any section shows $0.00 unexpectedly, go back and correct the missing entries. (7) Save the return as 'han_park.24t' in C:\Users\Docker\Documents\StudioTax.
